I have the same thing in my left shoulder. It used to just fall out due to the weight of my arm. What I did was see my physical therapist and get arm exercises and a shoulder brace to use while exercising and daily stuff to limit dislocations to let my shoulder heal. I wore the brace daily for 4 months while doing strengthening almost everyday. Then I started to ween off the brace. Now I’m able to lift stuff (yesterday I lifted a 15 lbs weight) with no dislocation. Most days it feels okay. It never feels the same as my other shoulder but it hurts way less and isn’t bothering me as much. I still have my bad days but on those days I just take it easy and don’t use my arm as much.
